mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors seek yield in equities during monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 7.0%) signal economic weakness and recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors reduce equity exposure amid deteriorating labor market conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signal imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns as capital flows shift to fixed income assets.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above 12-month average) indicate robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the 5-day horizon as earnings expectations rise from sustained consumption.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
